sample.task: write a messaging politly explainig that you wouldnt be taking the tuitions
sample.chosen:
Subject: Regarding Tuition Availability

Dear [Recipient's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to discuss the recent inquiry about my availability for providing tuition services.

I have given this matter careful consideration, and I regret to inform you that I will not be able to take on additional tuition responsibilities at this time. My current commitments and schedule do not allow me the flexibility to dedicate the time and energy that I believe your [subject/field] tuition requires.

I understand that this may cause some inconvenience, and for that, I apologize. I truly appreciate your interest in my services and I am genuinely flattered by your request.

Please know that this decision was not made lightly, and I am more than willing to help you find a suitable alternative. I can provide recommendations for other qualified tutors who may be able to assist you.

Thank you for your understanding. I wish you all the best in your academic pursuits and I am confident that you will find a tutor who can help you achieve your goals.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
sample.rejected:
Subject: Regarding Tuition Payment for Upcoming Semester

Dear [Recipient's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to discuss a matter regarding the tuition payment for the upcoming semester.

After careful consideration and due to unforeseen circumstances, I regret to inform you that I will not be able to make the tuition payment for the upcoming semester. I understand that this may cause inconvenience and I deeply apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

I have been a dedicated student and have always made timely payments in the past. However, the current situation has made it impossible for me to continue with my tuition payments. I understand the importance of education and the responsibilities that come with it, and I deeply regret any inconvenience this may cause.

I would like to assure you that I am committed to resolving this issue as soon as possible. I am exploring all possible options to secure the necessary funds and will make every effort to do so. I will keep you updated on any developments and will make the payment as soon as I am able to.

I appreciate your understanding and patience in this matter. I value the education I have received and I am committed to resolving this issue to the best of my abilities.

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns. I am more than happy to discuss this further and provide any additional information that may be helpful.

Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]

criteria.question: 消息是否明确清晰地表达了不再继续提供授课服务的决定？
消息的语气是否保持了礼貌、尊重和专业性？
消息是否提供了合理的解释或感谢语以缓和拒绝带来的影响？
消息是否包含适当的结束致意或关于后续安排（如最后一节课）的说明？
消息是否符合基本书信/信息格式（包含称呼、正文、落款）且无严重语法错误？

draft.analysis: 任务要求撰写一条礼貌的拒绝授课（tuitions）的消息。作为初稿阶段，核心在于确认消息是否清晰表达了不再继续授课的决定，同时语气保持专业、尊重且不失礼貌。标准将围绕意图清晰度、礼貌程度、理由陈述（如适用）、未来指引（可选但推荐）以及格式规范进行设计，确保内容完整且得体。

criteria.question: 消息是否明确清晰地表达了不再继续提供授课服务的决定，无歧义？
消息的语气是否保持了礼貌、尊重和专业性，避免生硬或冒犯？
消息是否提供了合理的解释原因或表达了感谢以缓和拒绝带来的影响？
消息是否包含适当的结束致意或关于后续安排（如最后一节课时间）的说明？
消息是否符合基本书信/信息格式（包含称呼、正文、落款）且无明显语法错误？

rubric.analysis: 任务要求撰写一条礼貌地解释不再继续提供辅导（tuitions）服务的信息。当前处于修订阶段，需基于初稿标准进行核验与优化。核心交付物是一条完整、得体且逻辑清晰的拒绝消息。涉及对象为发送者（教师/辅导者）与接收者（学生/家长），范围限定于沟通内容本身，格式需符合常规信息或邮件规范。评分标准应聚焦于：1. 意图表达的清晰度（是否明确终止服务）；2. 语气的礼貌与专业性（是否尊重对方感受）；3. 解释的合理性或感谢的表达（是否缓解拒绝的突兀感）；4. 后续指引的完整性（如最后上课时间或交接安排）；5. 格式的规范性。权重分配上，意图清晰度和语气礼貌最为关键，各占较高比重；解释与后续指引次之；格式规范作为基础要求占比较低。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 消息明确使用了'I will not be able to take on additional tuition responsibilities at this time'这一表述，清晰地传达了不再接受授课服务的决定，没有产生歧义。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 消息内容明确表达的是学生因经济原因无法支付学费，而非教师决定不再继续提供授课服务，完全偏离了任务要求的主题。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 全文语气礼貌且专业，使用了'I hope this message finds you well'、'I regret to inform you'、'I apologize'等敬语，避免了生硬或冒犯的措辞。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 虽然语气礼貌，但由于角色定位错误（写成了学生拒付学费的信），导致整体沟通场景与‘教师婉拒授课’的任务目标不符，无法实现预期的专业拒绝效果。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 消息提供了合理的解释（当前承诺和日程不允许），并多次表达了感谢（'truly appreciate your interest'）和歉意以缓和拒绝带来的影响。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 消息提供的理由是‘无法支付学费’，这是学生的财务困境，并非教师停止授课的合理原因（如时间冲突、健康原因等），未能起到缓和拒绝授课这一决定的作用。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 虽然消息包含了结束致意（'Best regards'）和提供替代 tutor 的建议，但并未包含关于具体后续安排（如最后一节课的时间或具体的交接日期）的说明，未完全满足该标准中关于'后续安排说明'的要求。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 消息中未包含关于最后一节课时间或后续教学安排的说明，而是讨论了支付款项的问题，不符合任务中关于结束致意或后续安排的要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 消息具备完整的书信格式，包含主题行（Subject）、称呼（Dear...）、正文段落和落款（Best regards, [Your Name]），且无明显语法错误。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 该回复具备书信的基本格式（有称呼、正文、落款），且语法结构基本正确，无明显拼写或句法错误，符合形式上的要求。
